spec.title: Guest CPU Pressure (PSI some)
spec.description: Percentage of time at least one task was stalled waiting for CPU. The axis grows to 100 only if a reading approaches it; on this fleet the busiest moment in 30 days was 2%, and a fixed 0-100 axis flattened all of that into the bottom pixel.

spec.title: Node Load Average per CPU
spec.description: Run-queue length divided by the node's CPU count, so 100% is a saturated node whatever its size. The hosts here run from 6 to 16 CPUs, which is why the raw averages are not comparable between them.

spec.expr:
node_hwmon_temp_celsius{chip=~".*_0000:00:18_.*", sensor="temp1"} * on(instance) group_left(nodename)
  (node_uname_info * on(nodename) group_left()
    label_replace(target_info{job="proxmox-ve", proxmox_node=~"$node"}, "nodename", "$1", "proxmox_node", "(.*)"))

smartmon_temperature_celsius_raw_value * on(instance) group_left(nodename)
  (node_uname_info * on(nodename) group_left()
    label_replace(target_info{job="proxmox-ve", proxmox_node=~"$node"}, "nodename", "$1", "proxmox_node", "(.*)"))

spec.title: Node ZFS ARC Size
spec.description: Only nodes with a pool imported appear; the others load the ZFS module but hold an empty ARC of about a kilobyte, which on a bytes axis beside a multi-gigabyte ARC is indistinguishable from zero while still occupying the legend. A node that gains a pool shows up here on its own.

spec.expr: count by (node) (proxmox_vm_cpu_percent{job="proxmox-ve", node=~"$node", type="lxc"}) or on(node) count by (node) (proxmox_node_cpustat_cpu_percent{job="proxmox-ve", node=~"$node"}) * 0
count by (node) (proxmox_vm_cpu_percent{job="proxmox-ve", node=~"$node", type="qemu"}) or on(node) count by (node) (proxmox_node_cpustat_cpu_percent{job="proxmox-ve", node=~"$node"}) * 0
